results.claim: Discrete dyadic shell summation-by-parts identity and telescoping uniform-weight shell sum hold to 80-dps
Spectral projectors e_+ and e_- in the quadratic algebra satisfy e_+^2=e_+, e_-^2=e_-, e_+ e_-=0, e_+ + e_-=1 and P_4(1)=24
Fiber adjoint involution satisfies (AB)^dagger = B^dagger A^dagger and tr(A^dagger A) = sum_{i,j} A_{ij}^2 > 0 for nonzero A
Two-strand planar state-sum transfer square (A I + A^{-1} U)^2 equals A^2 I + (1 - A^{-4}) U at loop weight d = -A^2 - A^{-2}
Weighted pivotal trace is strictly multiplicative on tensor products tr_{p otimes q}(A otimes B) = tr_p(A) tr_q(B)
